object: L17 raw endpoint formulas, arbitrary-context windows, exact counters and the bounded derived trace in the frozen handoff.
actor: Frozen Python rules, words and block evaluator.
critic: Separate declarative claims and separately written C++ literal-machine interpreter. No actor imports in the critic.
ambigator: Guard boundaries, alternating-run counts, suffix length and density, absolute translation, tape reflection, state renaming and equivalent chunk decompositions.
fuzzer: Deterministic fixed grids and independent seeded streams.
primary_metrics: Exact full tape, state, head, raw count and halting agreement.
Read-window locality with arbitrary nonzero context outside each window.
Mutation sensitivity, by defect class, with survivors disclosed.
kill: Any mismatch suspends the corresponding claim on that guard. Preserve the original failing record, shrink without extending a raw horizon and record any correction before rerunning.
stop: One frozen campaign within the declared counts and raw total; no orbit extension or richer tail rules in this hardening phase.
promotion: Passing finite checks strengthens M evidence only. No new Lean theorem, machine non-halting, complete stack closure, independent external replication or claimed performance gain.
provenance: The new specification is a separate transcription by the same author from the delivered statements; the actual consumed file hash will be recorded. No fresh-author or external independence is claimed.
